mapper.select: select rr.id, rr.restaurant_id, rr.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, rr.rating, rr.content, rr.created_at, rr.updated_at from restaurant_review rr inner join app_user u on u.id = rr.user_id where rr.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId} and rr.status = 'NORMAL' order by rr.updated_at desc, rr.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(1) from restaurant_review where restaurant_id = #{restaurantId} and status = 'NORMAL'
mapper.insert: insert into restaurant_review (restaurant_id, user_id, rating, content, status) values (#{restaurantId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, 'NORMAL') on duplicate key update rating = values(rating), content = values(content), status = 'NORMAL', updated_at = current_timestamp

insert into restaurant_rating_stat ( restaurant_id, rating_avg, review_count, rating_1_count, rating_2_count, rating_3_count, rating_4_count, rating_5_count ) select #{restaurantId}, coalesce(round(avg(rating), 2), 0.00), count(1), sum(case when rating = 1 then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when rating = 2 then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when rating = 3 then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when rating = 4 then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when rating = 5 then 1 else 0 end) from restaurant_review where restaurant_id = #{restaurantId} and status = 'NORMAL' on duplicate key update rating_avg = values(rating_avg), review_count = values(review_count), rating_1_count = values(rating_1_count), rating_2_count = values(rating_2_count), rating_3_count = values(rating_3_count), rating_4_count = values(rating_4_count), rating_5_count = values(rating_5_count), updated_at = current_timestamp
